cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The allotment committee's asking about the greenhouse. We arrived after the glass broke, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saw your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. We came inside afterwards. Can we both tell them we were clearing up?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll say that. I won't lie about the wheelbarrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then start with clearing up. If they ask about the barrow, we moved it away afterwards. Let's both use that order.

mechanism: A directs which truthful fragments B will repeat and in what order to maintain a shared protective account.
confusable: Unlike asking for a single endorsement, A rehearses coordinated memory and future answers to questions.
comparison: B refuses to lie about a wheelbarrow, unlike b's reinterpretation of cake crumbs as maintenance.
seedUse: Use greenhouse, wheelbarrow and cleanup sequence; the original's final orders give S01 a concrete role in D127 alignment.
